newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toco share slip continues to hit new lows.
newsitem.headline: Toco share slip continues to hit new lows.

text.p: Shares in South African industrial firm Toco Holdings Ltd continued their recent fall on Tuesday and sank to another year low.
The firm's stock lost six cents, or 15 percent, to hit 34 cents by 1215 GMT. More than 650,000 shares changed hands. As recently as last November the firm was trading at 380 cents.
"They just keep going down. The market has a very negative view of the stock," said one dealer.
The firm has been sliding most of the year and has been troubled by a series of profit-warnings.
It issued a profit warning in April, saying that full year attributable earnings had not been as favourable as it had anticipated.
Then on May 29 the firm said it had received an urgent provisional winding-up order for one of its subsidiaries, Inn Group Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
Full details of the effect of the wind-up on the earnings and asset value of Toco will be disclosed when the company publishes its year results at the end of June.
